newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae falls on single sell order.
newsitem.headline: Sonae falls on single sell order.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese retail and investment company Sonae Investimentos fell sharply after a big sell order from one broker, but dealers did not think the price would continue to drop.
At 1615 GMT the stock was down 80 escudos at 4,615 after earlier touching 4,600. A total 668,000 shares had changed hands.
"The transaction of 399,000 shares by a single broker was the maximum that could be traded and I think that there will be more to come," said one dealer.
"This is someone who is taking profits after Sonae reached new highs recently," said another trader.
But dealers said nothing fundamental had changed in the group's financial outlook, and they thought the selling would be absorbed.

"There was another operation just like this recently, also involving Sonae. It looks like it is a foreign investor who wants to get out and doesn't mind selling at a discount," the first dealer said. -- Lisbon editorial +(351-1) 3538254
